Name: No More Talking Walks - Abigail Marriage Dialogue Fix
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[b][UPDATE] [/b]Redone for the official 1.1 update. Also adds a few grammar fixes.

Abigail has a spelling error that will continually show up saying something about "talking a walk" (usually after mentioning the need to stretch her legs; Monday I think it is). This fix just changes it to "take a walk" as it should be. I may go more in to detail and scout this file for more errors eventually. I have noticed some other errors with grammar that slightly bothered me but not quite as much as this did. Plus the fact that I'm usually playing a while and forget what I meant to fix by the next save. I thought about adding some dialog along with working on other mods but I'm still waiting to see what's in the works for the next official update [1.1] otherwise I'll just be wasting my time. I didn't have a chance to take a screenshot before correcting the mistake so if someone has one, please, feel free to upload a picture.
